newsitem.title: USA: IntraNet retains advisor to seek capital.
newsitem.headline: IntraNet retains advisor to seek capital.

text.p: IntraNet Solutions Inc said Wednesday that it retained an investment banking firm, which is a member of the New York Stock Exchange, to act as its exclusive financial consultant.
The investment banking firm, which was not named, will act as IntraNet's consultant for one year to assist it in its capital formation efforts and to explore strategic opportunities.

IntraNet said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of 680,746 shares of common stock. This includes 245,579 shares being registered to allow resale by certain shareholders and up to 435,167 shares that would be issued by the company upon the exercise of outstanding warrants.
In the event that all the warrants are exercised, IntraNet Solutions would receive about $1.4 million, it added.
No underwriter is being used in connection with this offering.
IntraNet Solutions assists large companies in designing and implementing integrated solutions for managing and distributing information.
